verdict.rationale: Event subscriptions via webhooks are a fair question for a government online service such as MyFTB or Web Pay, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only records edge 403 denials at the front door and the application host, and contains nothing about registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
